diagnostics_category_patcher_description: DLL presence, signature, file lock state
diagnostics_category_storage_description: Storage path, free space, drive type
diagnostics_category_system_description: Windows version, WebView2, UAC, long paths
diagnostics_check_compat_flags_bad: Compatibility mode set on League or Riot executables
diagnostics_check_compat_flags_fix: Right-click each executable, open Properties → Compatibility, untick everything, then start the patcher again.
diagnostics_check_compat_flags_ok: No League or Riot compatibility entries found
diagnostics_check_compat_flags_warn: Compatibility entries on vinciskin or the patcher look wrong
diagnostics_check_free_space_bad: Less than 1 GB free on the storage drive
diagnostics_check_free_space_fix: Free up space on that drive, then rebuild the overlay.
diagnostics_check_free_space_warn: Less than 5 GB free on the storage drive
diagnostics_check_league_path_bad: Not configured, or the folder holds no League of Legends.exe
diagnostics_check_league_path_fix: Pick the folder that holds Game/League of Legends.exe in Settings.
diagnostics_check_league_running_fix: Close League before starting the patcher.
diagnostics_check_league_writable_fix: Give your account write access to League's Game folder, or install League somewhere under your user profile.
diagnostics_check_library_index_bad: The index cannot be read, or is corrupted
diagnostics_check_library_index_fix: Scan the library again; if it keeps failing, delete the index file so it is rebuilt.
diagnostics_check_long_paths_fix: Run the command below as administrator, then restart Windows.
diagnostics_check_long_paths_warn: Disabled — paths longer than 260 characters will fail
diagnostics_check_manager_admin_fix: Close VinciSkin and start it normally, without Run as administrator.
diagnostics_check_storage_in_league_bad: Mod storage is inside the League installation
diagnostics_check_storage_in_league_fix: Move mod storage outside the League install in Settings.
diagnostics_check_storage_medium_fix: Keep the mod storage folder on an SSD.
diagnostics_check_storage_medium_warn: HDD — building the overlay will be slow
diagnostics_check_storage_path_fix: Pick a folder you can write to in Settings.
diagnostics_check_storage_path_warn: The folder does not exist yet, and is created on first use
diagnostics_check_storage_writable_fix: Pick a writable folder for mod storage in Settings.
diagnostics_check_uac_fix: Turn UAC back on under Change User Account Control settings, then restart Windows.
diagnostics_check_version_bad: Older than the build League supports
diagnostics_check_version_fix: Install the latest cumulative update through Windows Update.
diagnostics_check_webview2_bad: Missing — the window cannot be drawn
diagnostics_check_webview2_fix: Install the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, then open VinciSkin again.
diagnostics_check_webview2_warn: Older than the app's build target — pages may fail to render
diagnostics_evidence_empty: Nothing was recorded for this game.
diagnostics_mod_disabled_description: {name} stays out of the next game.
diagnostics_overlay_disabled_label: Overlay turned off by the scan
diagnostics_report_copied_description: Paste it into a bug report or a support thread.

match.countPlural=one: League could not compile {count} shader variant.
match.countPlural=other: League could not compile {count} shader variants.

match.countPlural=one: League could not compile {count} shader variant, and then drew a material that had no pipeline.
match.countPlural=other: League could not compile {count} shader variants, and then drew a material that had no pipeline.

diagnostics_shader_pipeline_description: League drew a material that had no pipeline.
diagnostics_shader_unnamed_description: The failed compiles name no vertex shader. League builds shader programs only for the CustomShaderDef objects in data/shaders/shaders.bin, so a mod that defines a shader in any other bin replaces the game's copy with one that has no programs.
diagnostics_system_intro: Checks the most common reasons the patcher fails to load mods. Re-run after changing settings or a Windows update. All checks are read-only — fixes are shown as commands you can copy and run in an elevated terminal.
diagnostics_terminal_failed_title: Could not open the elevated terminal
diagnostics_terminal_no_copy_description: Copy the command from the row before running it.
diagnostics_terminal_opened_description: Paste with Ctrl+V and press Enter
hint.check-game-path: Check the League of Legends installation path in Settings.
hint.close-game: Close League of Legends and wait for it to exit, then start the patcher again.
hint.copy-report: Copy the report when you ask for help.
hint.disable-suspect: A mod that references a file it does not ship stops the read. Disable the suspect and play again.
hint.elevate: League may run elevated, so let the host elevate or run VinciSkin as administrator.
hint.free-memory: Close what else is running, and leave free space on the drive League is installed on.

match.countPlural=one: {count} modded archive was in this game. Disable any that replace textures with much larger ones and play again.
match.countPlural=other: {count} modded archives were in this game. Disable any that replace textures with much larger ones and play again.

hint.open-project: Open the project in the editor.
hint.reimport-mod: Re-import or rebuild the mod the scan named, then start the patcher again.
hint.remove-skinhack: Disable the mod the scan named, then start the patcher again.
hint.repair-game: Repair the install in the Riot Client, because the scan objected to a file the game ships.
hint.repair-install: Repair the install in the Riot Client when the rebuild does not help.
hint.scan-up-front: Turn on Scan every WAD up front, because the DLL scanned archives on demand and the game ended inside its first minute.
hint.shader-definition: Remove the CustomShaderDef that the mod defines outside data/shaders/shaders.bin, and keep the material's link to the game's shader.
hint.signature: The host ran elevated, so check the DLL's signature and whether an antivirus blocked it.
hint.system-checks: Run the System checks on the Diagnostics page.
hint.texture-dimensions: A modded texture whose width or height is not a multiple of 4 is the common cause, so check the dimensions of any texture you changed.
hint.update-driver: Update the graphics driver, and check the display settings when the update does not help.
